Hi Sara / Procurement team -

Thanks for the quick reply, Sara. Attach are the draft SOW and the preliminary quote (ballpark numbers to help with routing through finance). A few clarifications from our side to make procurement easier: 

- Commercial options:
  * PO (preferred for most enterprise customers): we can accept PO + net 30 payment terms; Redwood issues an invoice upon SOW execution.
  * Card: we can accept corporate card for pilot fees under your internal limit; note card processing fee applies.
  * Marketplace: Redwood is in the marketplace onboarding process; for Acme we can expedite if you prefer, but it typically takes 2-4 weeks and may require marketplace-specific terms.

- Signatory thresholds (Redwood standard):
  * Orders <= $25k: Sales rep + finance sponsor approval (email ok)
  * $25k- $100k: Procurement routing + finance sponsor sign-off
  * > $100k: Legal review + CFO signatory typically required

Next steps I propose:
1) Emily (finance) to confirm preferred payment method (PO vs card) and signatory thresholds.
2) Procurement to advise if Acme will accept Redwood's standard SOW language or whether you need a redline.
3) If PO: procurement to provide PO template and routing info (who issues PO, expected lead time).

If helpful, we can set a 15-20 min call with procurement + finance to speed alignment.
\Thanks - attaching the files again here.
\Regards,
--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
\Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf, Redwood-quote-ACME-20260324.xlsx

Hi Marissa / Sara -

Thanks for the materials. Short answers from procurement and finance: 

- Finance sponsor: Emily Chen (emily.chen@acme.com) - she is the point person for approvals and will review the SOW/quote.
- Preferred payment method: PO for pilots > $25k. Please route a formal PO once scope is agreed.
- Signatory path: 
  * Pilot $25k- $100k: Procurement + Finance sponsor approval; no CFO signature required.
  * > $100k: Legal & CFO approval required.
- Marketplace: We do not currently use Azure Marketplace for this type of procurement; direct PO is preferred to keep internal chargebacks accurate.
\Procurement will review SOW and provide any redlines within 3 business days. Please send the final SOW and an invoice template for our PO creation process.
\Thanks,
